problem:
Compute the following determinant using a cofactor expansion along the $3$rd row:

$$
|\begin{aligned}4 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -2 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & -1 & 2\end{aligned}|
$$

feedback.problem:
Compute the following determinant using a cofactor expansion along the $4$th row:

$$
|\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 4 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 4 \\ 3 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}|.
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using cofactor expansion along the $4$th row, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 4 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 4 \\ 3 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}| & =3\cdot {C}_{41}+0\cdot {C}_{42}+0\cdot {C}_{43}+1\cdot {C}_{44} \\  & =3\cdot (-1)^{4+1}\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & -2 & 4\end{aligned}|+1\cdot (-1)^{4+4}\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =-3|\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & -2 & 4\end{aligned}|+1|\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, computing the $3\times 3$ determinant by applying a Laplace expansion along the $2$nd row, we obtain: 

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & -2 & 4\end{aligned}| & =2\cdot {C}_{21}+0\cdot {C}_{22}+0\cdot {C}_{23} \\  & =2\cdot (-1)^{2+1}\cdot |\begin{aligned}4 & 1 \\ -2 & 4\end{aligned}| \\  & =-2|\begin{aligned}4 & 1 \\ -2 & 4\end{aligned}| \\  & =-2(16-(-2)) \\  & =-36\end{aligned}
$$

 
Finally, we compute the second $3\times 3$ determinant by applying a Laplace expansion along its $3$rd row:

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}| & =0\cdot {C}_{31}+1\cdot {C}_{32}+(-2)\cdot {C}_{33} \\  & =1\cdot (-1)^{3+2}\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}|+(-2)\cdot (-1)^{3+3}\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}|-2|\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =-(0-4)-2(2-2) \\  & =4+0 \\  & =4\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore,

$$
|\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 4 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 4 \\ 3 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|=-3\cdot (-36)+1\cdot 4=112.
$$
